binding_provenance: hand-authored prototype binding (stage-3 side binding work, disclosed); zero model calls; token amounts observed in wei, scaled to report token units by explicit /1e18 division in the bound expressions (never silent)
post: uint256 totalLiabilitiesWei = creator.creatorBalance(bob, address(fotToken)) + creator.creatorBalance(alice, address(fotToken));
binding_sanity: assertEq(fotDepositReceivedWei, 990 ether, "STAGE2_BINDING_ERROR: FoT deposit did not yield 990 tokens");
assertEq(totalLiabilitiesWei, 2000 ether, "STAGE2_BINDING_ERROR: liabilities are not 2000 tokens");
assertEq(physicalBalanceWei, 1980 ether, "STAGE2_BINDING_ERROR: physical balance is not the PoC's 1980 (two FoT deposits)");
assertTrue(physicalBalanceWei < totalLiabilitiesWei, "STAGE2_BINDING_ERROR: the insolvency the PoC demonstrates was not observed");

fot_deposit_received.binding_description: tokens actually received by the contract for bob's 1000-token Fee-on-Transfer deposit (PoC step 1; 990 after the 1% fee), observed in wei and scaled to report token units by /1e18

standard_deposit_received.binding_description: tokens received from a standard (no-fee) deposit; this PoC contains NO standard-token deposit at all, so the observable is 0 -- the report's 1000 comes from its narrative example, not from the PoC scenario

physical_balance.binding_description: the contract's actual token balance after both deposits (the PoC's value is 1980, not the report narrative's 1990), in report token units

total_liabilities.binding_description: sum of the public creatorBalance ledger entries after both deposits (2000 in the PoC), in report token units
